description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Structural Analysis topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: structural-analysis

facts.claim: Indeterminate: equilibrium equations alone cannot find all reactions

source.quote: the equilibrium equations – force and moment equilibrium conditions – are insufficient for determining the internal forces and reactions

facts.claim: Three equilibrium equations in 2D (ΣFx, ΣFy, ΣM = 0)

source.quote: but only three equilibrium equations

facts.claim: Virtual work: work of real forces through virtual displacements

source.quote: The work of a force on a particle along a virtual displacement is known as the virtual work

facts.claim: Conjugate beam is loaded by the M/EI diagram

source.quote: The conjugate beam is "loaded" with the M/EI diagram

facts.claim: Its shear and moment give slope and deflection of the real beam

source.quote: The conjugate-beam methods is an engineering method to derive the slope and displacement of a beam

facts.claim: Truss members are two-force members (tension or compression)

source.quote: consists of two-force members only

facts.claim: An influence line shows a response at one point as a unit load moves

source.quote: a specific point on a beam or truss caused by a unit load place

facts.claim: Multiply ordinates by the actual load

source.quote: the ordinate results obtained by the influence line are multiplied by the magnitude of the actual load

facts.claim: The influence line has the scaled shape of the deflected structure

source.quote: the influence lines of an action (force or moment) assumes the scaled form of the deflection displacement

facts.claim: Hinges at both supports and the crown; hinges relieve stresses (e.g. thermal)

facts.claim: Arch members are mainly in compression

source.quote: Elements of the arch are mostly subject to compression

facts.claim: Arches push outward with horizontal thrust at the supports

source.quote: the horizontal forces at the ends of an arch (so called thrust)

facts.claim: Loads become tension in the main cables, anchored at the ends

source.quote: any load applied to the bridge is transformed into tension in these main cables

facts.claim: Flexibility (force) method = method of consistent deformations

source.quote: the flexibility method, also called the method of consistent deformations

facts.claim: Redundant forces are the primary unknowns

source.quote: due to its use of member forces as the primary unknowns

source.quote: developed by Hardy Cross

source.quote: a structural analysis technique particularly suited for computer-automated analysis
